name: Análisis de Balance de Blancos
description: Analiza color temperature consistency a través de the image. AI images may show inconsistent balance de blancos or unnatural color cast patrones.
algorithm: Gray World + Color Temperature Consistency Analysis
mechanism: Estimates balance de blancos using gray world assumption and analiza color temperature consistency a través de image regions.
parameters: Method: gray world, Region análisis: block-based
source: Van de Weijer et al. (2007), IEEE TIP
useCase: Detecting balance de blancos inconsistencias in AI images

references.title: Van de Weijer, J. et al. (2007). Edge-based Color Constancy. IEEE TIP.
Riess, C. & Angelopoulou, E. (2010). Scene Illumination as an Indicator of Image Manipulation. Information Hiding.
Gijsenij, A. et al. (2011). Computational Color Constancy: Survey and Experiments. IEEE TIP.

strengths:
• Detecta color temperature inconsistencias a través de regions
• Based on physics of iluminación and surface reflectance
• Effective for composite image detección
• Multiple illuminant estimation algorithms available
• Reveals AI color cast artefactos
limitations:
• Mixed lighting scenes naturally have varying color temperatures
• Auto balance de blancos correction normalizes results
• Narrow dynamic range reduces detección sensibilidad
• Colored objects can bias regional estimates
• Post-processing color grading masks inconsistencias
